svg.title: SCP complete hardware architecture — the finished machine
svg.desc: Complete hardware layout of the Sempaevum Computing Platform showing the ET-native chip with 7 units, three-domain hybrid architecture (analog, digital, quantum), free-air holographic display, keyboard, power supply, and storage, all within the enclosure.
svg.text: P ∘ D ∘ T = E — every component from raw materials — every atom Mike's

g.text: ET-native chip (fabricated by Mike from raw silicon)

svg.text: Digital (P∘D) — exact k, d, flags, tensor, memo, bus
Analog (D) — continuous ε, projection, pullback, codec, observatory
Quantum (T) — NV qubits, T-acts, measurement, κ-correction
All three domains connected by the bijection Π_N with ZERO information loss (IC-1).
Universal free codec (IC-127): one codec for all signals — audio, video, sensor, network.
Every transistor, every circuit, every tool built from raw materials by Mike.
